steps.content:
In N.F. 113, this March, chaos erupts in the West District due to the Rustfire Uprising. Unexpectedly, BR-002 is reactivated three days ahead of schedule, and its capabilities far exceed our projections.

SHP-13 has gone missing, and we suspect its sensory systems are being tampered with.

Upon verification of the anomalous data by the Paradeisos analysis team, it quickly became evident that the Underground Shepherd is implicated, and they're actively seeking a method to infiltrate BR-002. The 9th Agency's lead intelligence officers have swiftly pivoted to pursuing these Underground forces.

Attempts to recover SHP-13 have been unsuccessful and are currently suspended.

In April, the FAC Commander-in-Chief urgently enacts an emergency protocol, decisively mobilizing operations in the West District. The main forces are redeployed from Eastside to the West, triggering the city-wide Blue Rain initiative and exacerbating the financial strain on the city-state.

SHP-13 remains unaccounted for.
In N.F. 113, this June, the battle for control of BR-002 has reached a tense stalemate. Concurrently, a covert operation is being conducted in the shadows.

7:20 p.m., June 21, N.F. 113
The periphery of Syndicate-controlled BR-002.
The resurrected Black Ring looms ominously over the city, its streets awash in a cacophony of roars and curses. Here and there, the fading glimmers of a Sinner's special power can be glimpsed.

steps.speaker: Tactical Operative
steps.content: The intel is rock-solid; our target is right here. Minos' Chief has been hidden out in this location!

steps.speaker: Tactical Operative
steps.content: Whose turf is this? Rustfire? Some other gang? Or could it be those Underground types—

steps.speaker: Tactical Operative
steps.content: It doesn't matter, and it's not important. What's crucial is that we retrieve him today.
steps.female_content: It doesn't matter, and it's not important. What's crucial is that we retrieve her today.

steps.speaker: Tactical Operative
steps.content: With the Hush on-site, there's no way we're losing this.
A blinding burst of white light emanates from the core of Schorl, forcefully obliterating the barriers ahead.
Debris flies in all directions, while a haze of dust and smoke obscures what lies deeper in the tunnel.
Yet, undeterred, the Hush strides forward towards the enigmatic abyss. Her expression is one of chilling detachment.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: X, prioritize your safety. You're not cut out for the front lines, and we've gone over the risks already.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This is merely a special deployment; your role is to validate the intel and issue commands. You're not expected to engage in combat.

Shalom doesn't reply; she's well aware. This risky, covert operation has flirted with danger multiple times. Moments like this were bound to occur. If it weren't for the suspicions raised by the 9th Agency, compelling Paradeisos to clandestinely reassign HUSH to helm the operation, keeping it under wraps would have been quite difficult.

There's no time left; she can't rely on Rebel and must find the target herself. She remembers the bits of scattered intel she caught a glimpse of earlier, rummaging for lost medical supplies amid the chaos—particularly the Hypercube.
Whoosh!
A bullet pierces through the smoke, shot towards Shalom, but is intercepted by Schorl.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This gear— it's from <color=#fb9259>Rustfire</color>, isn't it? Just as I thought, they've gotten their hands on it.

Sure, it's Rustfire ammo, but if one has been paying attention, they'd know there's more to it. The situation here is even more intricate than it seems—everything from resources to tactics, customs, and temperament come into play.
Shalom has someone in mind.
As the first shot pierces the air, additional barrels materialize from the gloom, effectively restraining the combat forces.

However, Shalom vanishes into the maelstrom of bullets, locating the clandestine door she's been searching for all along. She navigates the hidden passage, finally reaching a securely sealed iron door.
She pushes it open.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The Chief is located. You've done well.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: He remains manageable for the moment. HUSH Elite will arrive shortly for retrieval; your only job is to keep him alive. Remain on standby here.
steps.female_content: She remains manageable for the moment. HUSH Elite will arrive shortly for retrieval; your only job is to keep her alive. Remain on standby here.

steps.content: Light cascading from above cleaves the room into distinct halves.
Shalom refrains from stepping into the luminous divide. She lingers by the bed, scrutinizing the figure ensnared by the light, as she finds solace in the surrounding darkness.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes, he's very weak...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: A rare opportunity indeed. Let me do a test.
Shalom slowly walks over.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...I've come to see you, ${PlayerName}.
The listener's face lies veiled in the glow of the ceiling lamp—still as the night, as though in slumber, but their breathing is so faint it's almost indiscernible.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You've slimmed down; you look rather pallid. It's as if all the Bureau's hard work over the past six months has come to naught. Your adjutant must be concerned.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Your hair has grown, reminding me of the first time we met.

Shalom gently caresses ${PlayerName}'s forehead and the side of their face. The person in the bed appears to be enveloped in a dream, their eyes darting beneath closed eyelids as if striving to awaken. Shalom waits a moment, but ultimately, they remain ensnared in their dreamworld.
Shalom gently grazes their fingertips; this time, with no fabric between them, both hands share the same coldness.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I did all this.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The Black Ring, the uprisings, even your path—everything has been calculated to lead us here.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Can you hear my words? You must despise me by now...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...Then come back. Try it; I want to bring you back.
Shalom's voice gradually diminishes, nearly fading into a whisper.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Do you want to mark him?
steps.female_content: Do you want to mark her?

steps.content: Her expression is enigmatic, shrouded in shadows. Darkness writhes around her, tendrils of dim light creeping up the bed. These wisps encircle Shalom, as though yearning to caress the person lying there.

The line between light and dark blurs; those ethereal filaments become the brightest luminescence in the room, piercing through windows, cutting across the wide-open door, and ultimately weaving together to envelop the two in a radiant cocoon.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This time, the shackles don't recoil...
Shalom remains silent, her grip on the hand of the person in the bed unyielding. Shalom stares at him intently, as if entranced.
steps.female_content: Shalom remains silent, her grip on the bedridden person's hand is unwavering. She stares at her intently, as if entranced.

steps.content: Simultaneously, a dense corruption seeps from ${PlayerName}, instantly ensnaring the wisp of light and nearly consuming it whole.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Hush! Move, it's the Mania of Corpus 02!
A burst of blue light pierces through Shalom instantly. Concurrently, an electric hum emanates from beyond the open door.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Alert!
Zaaaap! Before Schorl can activate, a surge of electricity immobilizes it, forcibly propelling it through the window.
Finally.

Shalom finally releases ${PlayerName}'s hand and stands up tall. The blue light that enveloped her vanishes, leaving behind faint scorch marks. She doesn't seem to mind; her composure suggests that all of it might as well have been an act.
She turns her attention to the lone onlooker who interrupted her show. Evidently, he was drawn by the light—quick on the uptake. A satisfied smile graces Shalom's face.
The cloaked man bursts into the basement, a one-man army fueled by palpable tension; his muscles are rigid with anticipation. An electric charge surges along his weapon, coursing toward Shalom.
Back off. Don't even think about using your tricks.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Ahhh!

The electric glow shatters under the weight of intangible Awe; the last vestiges of his power make a defiant lunge at Shalom, only to dissipate into thin air. Donald is immobilized by unseen restraints, his weapon plummeting to the ground with a resonant clang.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: So frightened? You should've seized the chance to kill me when you had it.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Nine years</color> without using your power—must be quite the struggle to hold back, isn't it? You know, if you just let go of that animosity and show me a little kindness, you wouldn't have to worry about me manipulating you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: See how alive and kicking you still are right now. You owe some of that to me, don't you think?
She looks at the man pinned to the ground.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It's been a while, <color=#fb9259>Representative of the Inner Bay</color>. Or should I say... <color=#fb9259>Leader of Rustfire</color>?
Her eyes narrow in a smile. That grin instantly triggers a shiver in Donald, jolting long-buried memories to the surface as he visibly scratches at his rising goosebumps.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: No, no, no, better we never cross paths again. Could you turn back? This humble abode of mine is ill-suited for one such as you—

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: An utter monster!

This is hardly the time for nostalgia. With a clenched fist, electrical arcs dance again. An iron basin nearby hurtles toward Shalom. She dodges, her eyes flickering with triangular flashes. A muffled grunt escapes Donald, as if he's been violently slammed to the ground.
Simultaneously, a gunshot reverberates, shattering the remaining glass of the window—a bullet penetrates Shalom's throat without resistance. Collapsing forward, she hits the ground.

Almost instantaneously, the sniper's perch is obliterated by a cascade of blue light. Struggling, Donald rushes to the sickbed, hoists the frail figure onto his shoulders, and pivots to flee. Just then, a voice resounds within him.
Run... Run as far as you can with him; if you're found again, it's all over.
steps.female_content: Run... Run as far as you can with her; if you're found again, it's all over.

steps.content: He wants to say something more, but immediately reminds himself that this is no time for hesitation.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Yikes—goosebumps! There's a ghost!
He grabs the person and vanishes like smoke. Quickly, Schorl re-enters the deranged ward, coolly evaluating Shalom's injuries.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The situation outside has become abundantly clear. It appears we're entangled in some sort of spatial incantations, likely connected to the Underground.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The ones who assaulted me and aimed at you are all Sinners. The damage they've inflicted will require significant time to mend. I really shouldn't have pushed you to take the front lines.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your recent behavior was dangerously excessive. Upon our return, we'll have you undergo a thorough evaluation.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Exercise greater caution, X. You're not just an exceptional Hush; you're also a high-value target.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: If there’s even a whisper of a chance you could be compromised, I'll be forced to enact an emergency protocol to eliminate you then and there. I would much prefer to part ways with you amicably when your term of service concludes.
Shalom manages a smile, her throat wound sparing her the need to speak. Blood oozes from the gash, rapidly sapping her strength.
Yet she's pulled through this perilous moment. From this point forward, that man will undoubtedly exercise greater caution; he has the aptitude for it.
Still, it's insufficient. More safeguards must be layered onto him—safeguards that cannot raise any alarms...
steps.female_content: Still, it's insufficient. More safeguards must be layered onto her—safeguards that cannot raise any alarms...

steps.content: The Hush closes her eyes, focusing on the slow process of healing. Although the battlefield is out of reach for now, she cherishes this rare moment of solitude for reflection and rest.
As the pivotal moment draws near, her long-buried memories grow increasingly vivid. Every now and then, she wants to pause and savor them—let's refer to it as "dreaming," for lack of a better word.
I've been transformed into an instrument for human well-being, stripped of my desires, and eradicated of impulsivity, all in the pursuit of becoming a rational cornerstone.

My heart has been severed, transformed into an alien entity, laden with unyielding shackles, and banished to realms where humans fear to venture, exiled into the void. It is tasked with observing the Mania within the abyss far removed from reality, in search of humanity's elusive "ultimate answer."

Through the rift, I observe its agony, fury, struggles, and wails day after day. I watch as it grotesquely oppresses its own kind—yet I remain utterly unmoved. I possess no heart with which to feel pain.
...Can I even be considered human anymore?
I guess not.

I underwent an indoctrination of reason, becoming an instrument for humanity. Until the day my usefulness corrodes and I become unreliable, a new instrument will emerge to take my place. I recognize the logic and soundness of this cycle.
Any ethereal ripples of emotion, any lingering doubts, will find their most rational explanations—only to be systematically extinguished by reason.
Reason was the armor bestowed upon me.
Until another monster shattered it.
The adjutant storms out of the holding cell, nearly colliding with the Hush. Visibly shaking and emotionally wrought, she finds herself at a loss for words upon encountering her commanding officer.
The Hush wordlessly steps aside to let Nightingale pass, then enters the room with a composed smile, ready to perform its duties with precision.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Good evening, I'm from the Hush unit. You can call me Shalom.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: My mission is to neutralize any lingering side-effects from prior operations, stabilizing your condition in the process. Rest assured, this will ease your suffering.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You look like you've been through hell. Let me take it from here; I can offer you a way out.
Don't touch me!!
...Mark my words, you'll regret this. If you don't end me now, you're in for a world of pain!
I will never forgive, never!!

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Long time no see, you seem upbeat.
Shalom opens her eyes to find Schorl hovering in front of her.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: A month has passed, and you have less than 50 days remaining. Your next mission involves the Garden, the Underground sorcery, and the gateway. The stakes are high. Are you sure you want to go?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It's okay. Tools are meant to serve a purpose.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The shackles have vanished, the Black Ring is unraveling, and even the Underground stirs. Paradeisos calls for me. Before my replacement steps in, I shall conclude my final task for the 7th tenure.
It takes a week to recover from a serious injury. During that downtime, I'll likely be subjected to all sorts of tests again.
After all, there was that brief moment when I escaped Schorl's surveillance, and my time of usefulness is running out. For them, recognizing the increased risk is a wise decision.
The thing is, the root cause has long been implanted. A rift they failed to catch in the first 17 inspections—she's learned to hide it even better since.
Until the day it's finally discovered and destroyed.
Don't think I'll forget, ${PlayerName}. You're the one who chiseled this fracture into my hollow shell.

For the first time, I felt pain, shock, and fear. Since that moment, the rift within me has widened, corrupting the purity of my thoughts. As I gaze upon the "heart" that's been affixed, I find no room for hatred.
Only doubt.

<size=38>X </size>　　　　<size=50>Risk control</size>　　　<size=52>Directive</size> <size=50>Required Sacrifices</size>
　　　　　　　　 No Other Choice <size=38>All to Counter <color=#fb9259><size=52>Mania</color></size>
　　　　　　　　<size=52>Being Rational<size=52> is Being Right</size>　<size=52>Underground<size=52> are all enemies
　　　 <size=42>Take Action 　　<size=48>Now!</size> 　　<size=54>Now!</size>　　<size=60>Now!</size>

　　　　　　　　　　　 You're doing great

Cowardice is masked as caution, apathy is spun as reason, cruelty turns into resolve, and stubbornness becomes determination. Those who deem themselves righteous shy away from their destiny, pushing the burden onto others.
All my feelings were snuffed out by such cowards?
See, it's at this very moment that a tool breaks

If things keep going this way, my readings will lose their accuracy. Mania will breach the rift, corrupting the HUSH system and making me deviate from my original purpose. I'd become a menace to humanity.
But haven't I already been reduced to a mere tool?
Dehumanized for so long,
should I still prioritize human welfare?
Perhaps... it's not necessary anymore.
Hehe, just kidding, I do like humans. They let me catch a glimpse of... the me that's long been dead.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You...

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Go to hell!!!
Back off. Don't even think about using your tricks.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Shalom! You're back!
The impenetrable armor has shattered, allowing past elusive emotions to come to the fore—no longer suppressed or extinguished by "rationality."
At last, these feelings are acknowledged, named, and tenderly embraced by HUSH-X, marking Shalom's rebirth.
Thank you for shattering me, ${PlayerName}. Everything that emerged twisted yet born anew from the rift you created, I hold dear.

Pleasure or desire, highs and lows, profound emotional ties—what I've experienced in the rift over the past year surpasses all that I've witnessed in the ocean of consciousness during the last eight years.
Is this the feeling of a heart reborn?
She closes her eyes and lightly taps Schorl, this time embracing the pointless Level 1 Scan with a smile.
The beast that once tore me apart—I've severed his chains and wrested it from the grasp of Paradeisos.
steps.female_content: The beast that once tore me apart—I've severed her chains and wrested it from the grasp of Paradeisos.

steps.content: When he awakens... will he revert to his former self and bare his fangs at you once more?
steps.female_content: When she awakens... will she revert to her former self and bare her fangs at you once more?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My position remains unwavering. I genuinely want to safeguard my present. And I don't believe there's anything about who I am now that the person I was before would despise.
Hmm, you have a point... What we've lost can't be reclaimed, but we're destined for renewal.
A "flawed entity" capable of bypassing the HUSH tech barrier and stealthily eliminating the Hush without detection must inherently possess qualities unlike any of the SHPs she's ever dealt with.
A creation that has been memory-wiped, perpetually assimilates Mania, yet still holds onto his humanity, certainly warrants deep investigation for his unique approaches to tackling disasters.
steps.female_content: A creation that has been memory-wiped, perpetually assimilates Mania, yet still holds onto her humanity, certainly warrants deep investigation for her unique approaches to tackling disasters.

steps.content: In a <color=#fb9259>person</color> more daring to confront destiny than any set of "righteous rules," we can perhaps expect him to navigate a unique path amidst adversity.
steps.female_content: In a <color=#fb9259>person</color> more daring to confront destiny than any set of "righteous rules," we can perhaps expect her to navigate a unique path amidst adversity.

steps.content: Paradeisos lacks the courage to face it, let the Hush remove the obstacles; she has already succeeded.
Just as he granted me freedom, I now return that freedom to you, along with the power you once lost.
steps.female_content: Just as she granted me freedom, I now return that freedom to you, along with the power you once lost.

steps.content: The monster that once shattered me will surely be able to dismantle all this foolishness once it wakes up, won't it?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You won't let me down, will you?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Unfortunately, it looks like I'll have to miss out on such an exhilarating battle.

July 19, N.F. 113, Eastside District 01

Erica Villa
Shalom steps out of the car. The Blue Rain won't fall for another two days, but tonight the moonlight is still visible.
The timing is perfect; her heart balanced on the edge—too much and she'd be wallowing in self-pity, too little and she'd be complacent. She's poised to make a choice, to act.
What comes next is my endgame. May I find the Ultimate Answer.
She smiles as she takes measured steps towards what appeared to be a grand mansion, yet was nothing more than a trap—all while holding onto her customary line of thought.

<size=40>FAC is unwavering</size>　　　<size=50>The Blockade Operation</size> is certain to happen.
　　　　　　　　　We're aiming for <size=40>August</size>　to discreetly help them build trust.
　　　　<size=40>This serves as a <size=40>diversion<size=40>;　the real operation needs a <size=40>smokescreen.</size>
　　　<size=40>But they can not get their hands on <size=40>${PlayerName}<size=40>　　The 9th Agency　　MBCC are off-limits as well.
　<size=40>Avoid Paradeisos<size=40>　　Employ some tactics　　Hand it over to <size=40>HUSH　　<size=40>I've got them under control.
　　　　Adapt to that individual's abilities; <size=40>He's no slouch.<size=40> They must have powers that are beyond my grasp.
　　　　　　　　　In these final moments　　what else can I manage to send their way?

<size=56><color=#fb9259>The Garden</color><size=40> is our first choice.　　<size=40>The blade hidden Underground.<size=40>
　　　　　　　　So far, this minor action is the only one　　 that risks <size=40>coercion.<size=40><size=40>
　　<size=50>Verify first, <size=36>then <size=50>utilize.<size=36>
　　limited intel|<size=40>A face-to-face meeting<size=36> is the best way for actual confirmation. What to do?
The plan? Lure her here for a face-to-face verification? <size=40>Would that be risking my life?<size=36>
　　　　　　　Even the S-Class have limits, she alone can't surpass <size=40>Schorl.

Thought can lead to the Ultimate Answer, but for how long can I keep thinking?
The Garden can be my end, as can Schorl and the Underground.
If I manage to survive but suffer another grave injury, at the current rate of healing, I doubt I'll catch up.
I lack the means to defend myself, so caution is my only ally. Buying time is, in essence, gaining efficiency and results.
And I must make plans for what happens after I'm gone; I can't leave without tying up loose ends…

How many options do I have, who else can I trust, how far can the current me go...
Are there any loopholes to exploit, what should I zero in on, what will they focus on, how can I sidestep surveillance...
Being alone really feels like treading on thin ice; the odds of pulling this off are less than 1%.
But it's all right. Fate is not an enemy; the human spirit is eternally fluid. <color=#fb9259>X's</color> reason confronts every obstacle, seizing every variable to find an answer.
And when she starts to calculate in this way, regardless of the outcome... <color=#fb9259>Shalom</color> has already triumphed.
The heart they stole has been rejuvenated, flourishing with each passing moment, all while they remain unaware.
Moonlight bathes Shalom, impartially casting its glow on each intertwining fate soon to alter one another.

It's been three months since the young detective last heard that unmistakable ringtone. She's pacing in circles, caught in a dilemma: Should she call her beloved Shalom right away, or should she wait until her summer internship is set in stone before seeking her out?

Simultaneously, Coquelic has successfully evaded the HUSH troops that were after her and made it back to the Garden. To her dismay, she discovers her cherished purple carnation is missing. Filled with rage, she slices through the folding screen, grabs her floral sword, and finally makes a long-overdue decision.
The guard clad in black ventures into the depths of the night. Though haunted by nightmares and facing a point of no return, she's resolute in walking this path to its end.

The Hush may not yet perceive the undercurrents converging around her, but when she sees the glint of a blade slicing through the cold moonlight aimed in her direction, she knows this is the beginning.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: If you want to hate, hate the fact that you were born in Paradeisos!
It wasn't a fatal blow; Schorl's didn't attack as planned. Shalom's right shoulder blade was pierced, causing her to fall.
As the battle erupts, emotional and strategic undercurrents surge, yet all she sees are petals drifting into her pool of blood, as her thoughts wander...
<i>...Ah, the beauty of blooming flowers even here.<i>
Life's path is unforgiving, yet may we both find...
final freedom.
